answer.justification: Median first divergence is 0 and edit distance is 0.786, which matches system-prompted (0.79-0.82) and not quantized (10-17) or fine-tuned (5.5-8). Logit values also fit: top-1 agreement 0.865, KL 0.429 (slightly above the 0.197-0.339 range) and DiFR gap 0.529. Activations show the system-prompt signature: layer-1 L2 0.141 climbing with onset at layer 8 to a 0.478 plateau at layer 16, 0.501 at layer 32, effective rank 2.77, cosine 0.849 and raw-score shift ÷ TV 3.7. Mid-layer size ratio 0.972 is just below 1, also consistent. The layer-2 spike of 0.1 is far below the documented 31.7-64.0, which is the one oddity. Fine-tuned is ruled out by the immediate divergence, high edit distance and a plateau shape. Quantized is ruled out by the much larger activation and logit shifts.
